preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= m <= 10**6 for n, m in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n')))
preconditions.description: For each test case, n (number of residents/cats) and m (number of friendship pairs) satisfy 1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n') and ' ' in line)
preconditions.description: Each friendship pair (a_i, b_i) has resident index a_i and cat index b_i in the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(any(a_i == i and b_i == i for a_i, b_i in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n') and ' ' in line)) for i in range(1, n+1))
preconditions.description: For every resident i, there exists a friendship pair (i, i) indicating the resident knows their own cat.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'No' or (stdout.strip() == 'Yes' and any('Yes' in line for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is either 'No' (impossible) or starts with 'Yes' followed by valid jury and contestant selections.

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'Yes') and all('No' in line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'No')
postconditions.description: Each test case output is either 'No' or starts with 'Yes' followed by valid selections.

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in line and (line.split()[1] == 'j' and line.split()[2] == 'p' and int(line.split()[1]) + int(line.split()[2]) == n) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'Yes')
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', the second line contains integers j and p such that j + p = n, where j is the number of jury members and p is the number of contestants.

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in line and (len(set(jury)) == j and len(set(contestants)) == p) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'Yes' and (jury := [int(x) for x in next(line.splitlines()).split()]) and (p := int(line.split()[2])) and (contestants := [int(x) for x in next(line.splitlines()).split()]))
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', the jury and contestant lists contain exactly j and p distinct integers respectively.

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in line and all(1 <= x <= n for x in jury) and all(1 <= x <= n for x in contestants) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'Yes' and (jury := [int(x) for x in next(line.splitlines()).split()]) and (contestants := [int(x) for x in next(line.splitlines()).split()]))
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', all jury and contestant indices are within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in line and all(a_i not in contestants or b_i not in jury for a_i, b_i in friendships) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'Yes' and (jury := [int(x) for x in next(line.splitlines()).split()]) and (contestants := [int(x) for x in next(line.splitlines()).split()]) and (friendships := [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n') and ' ' in line)]))
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', no resident in the jury knows any cat in the contestants (i.e., no friendship pair (a_i, b_i) exists where a_i is in jury and b_i is in contestants).

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in line and (j > 0 and p > 0) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'Yes' and (j := int(line.split()[1])) and (p := int(line.split()[2])))
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', the number of jury members j and contestants p are both at least 1.
